t: What to do immediately after a slip
a: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
p: Ittaqi-llāha ḥaythumā kunt, wa atbiʿi-s-sayyi'ata-l-ḥasanata tamḥuhā, wa khāliqi-n-nāsa bi-khuluqin ḥasan.
m: Fear Allah wherever you are, follow a bad deed with a good one and it will wipe it out, and treat people with good character.
